items.title: Draft Deeper's 2026 NBA Draft Lessons: How to Evaluate Guards
items.body_excerpt: I’ve wanted to return to my “How to Evaluate by Position” series because, honestly, the way I look at guards keeps evolving. The 2026 NBA Draft class gave me a lot to wrestle with. Kingston Flemings, Darius Acuff Jr., Mikel Brown Jr., Labaron Philon Jr., Christian Anderson,…
